ko.title: 티어표 만들기 | 원픽게임
ko.description: 원픽게임에서 나만의 티어표를 만들어보세요. 기존 이상형 월드컵 후보를 불러오거나 직접 이미지를 추가해 S, A, B, C, D 등급으로 정리할 수 있습니다.

en.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
en.description: Create your own tier list on One Pick Game. Reuse candidates from existing brackets or add your own images and rank them from S to D.

ja.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
ja.description: One Pick Gameで自分だけのTier Listを作成。既存トーナメントの候補を再利用するか画像を追加してS〜Dに分類できます。

zh.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
zh.description: 在 One Pick Game 创建自己的 Tier List。可复用现有淘汰赛候选项或上传图片，并按 S 到 D 分级。

ru.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
ru.description: Создайте свой tier list на One Pick Game. Используйте готовых кандидатов или добавьте изображения и распределите их от S до D.

pt.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
pt.description: Crie sua própria tier list no One Pick Game. Reutilize candidatos existentes ou adicione imagens e classifique de S a D.

es.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
es.description: Crea tu propia tier list en One Pick Game. Reutiliza candidatos existentes o añade tus imágenes y ordénalos de S a D.

fr.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
fr.description: Créez votre tier list sur One Pick Game. Réutilisez des candidats existants ou ajoutez vos images et classez-les de S à D.

id.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
id.description: Buat tier list milikmu di One Pick Game. Gunakan kandidat yang sudah ada atau tambahkan gambar lalu susun dari S hingga D.

hi.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
hi.description: One Pick Game पर अपनी tier list बनाएं। मौजूदा उम्मीदवारों का उपयोग करें या अपनी तस्वीरें जोड़कर S से D तक रैंक करें।

de.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
de.description: Erstelle deine eigene Tier List auf One Pick Game. Nutze vorhandene Kandidaten oder eigene Bilder und ordne sie von S bis D ein.

vi.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
vi.description: Tạo tier list của riêng bạn trên One Pick Game. Dùng lại ứng viên có sẵn hoặc thêm ảnh và xếp từ S đến D.

ar.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
ar.description: أنشئ Tier List خاصة بك على One Pick Game. استخدم المرشحين الحاليين أو أضف صورك ورتّبهم من S إلى D.

bn.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
bn.description: One Pick Game-এ নিজের tier list তৈরি করুন। আগের প্রার্থী ব্যবহার করুন বা ছবি যোগ করে S থেকে D পর্যন্ত সাজান।

th.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
th.description: สร้าง tier list ของคุณบน One Pick Game ใช้ผู้สมัครเดิมหรือเพิ่มรูปภาพแล้วจัดอันดับตั้งแต่ S ถึง D

tr.title: Tier List Maker | One Pick Game
tr.description: One Pick Game üzerinde kendi tier listeni oluştur. Mevcut adayları kullan veya görsel ekleyip S ile D arasında sırala.

it.title: Crea classifiche a livelli | One Pick Game
it.description: Crea la tua lista di livelli su One Pick Game. Riutilizza i candidati dai tornei esistenti o aggiungi le tue immagini e classificale da S a D.

pl.title: Kreator rankingów | One Pick Game
pl.description: Stwórz własną listę poziomów na One Pick Game. Ponownie wykorzystaj kandydatów z istniejących turniejów lub dodaj własne obrazy i ranking ich od S do D.

nl.title: Tierlijst maken | One Pick Game
nl.description: Maak uw eigen lijst op One Pick Game. Hergebruik kandidaten van bestaande toernooien of voeg uw eigen afbeeldingen en rangschikk ze van S tot D.

cs.title: Tvorba žebříčků | One Pick Game
cs.description: Vytvořte si vlastní seznam úrovní na One Pick Game. Znovu použít kandidáty ze stávajících turnajů nebo přidat své vlastní obrázky a řadit je od S do D.
